name: Khushi Juneja
positioning: Math (Operations Research & Statistics) and HCI at Carnegie Mellon. I build software, run research, and design things people use.
currently: Interning at PLUS, TA'ing precalculus, and building a trashbot.
about: I am a builder and a researcher. I make software, games, and hardware, and I like the stretch between them: a scavenger-hunt app one month, a claw-armed robot the next.

Most of my research has been in learning-science labs, where the real job is measuring whether a thing actually worked, not whether it looked good in a demo. That habit follows me into everything I build. I care about AI systems and how you evaluate them, human-computer interaction, operations research and statistics, game design, and physical computing. The thread tying them together is making something people use, then being honest about how well it did.
